title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: A stereo-EEG (SEEG) benchmark dataset from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, containing ictal (seizure) and interictal segments recorded at 2000 Hz. It includes clinical information and channel-level epileptogenic-zone annotations. The data are re-packaged in iEEG-BIDS from the authors' public Zenodo release without signal processing, and the dataset also carries the authors' HFO detection code and result tables.
methods_description: SEEG segments were recorded at 2000 Hz, with ictal segments typically 40-60 s and interictal segments longer. The original MATLAB arrays were converted losslessly to BrainVision float32 with BIDS sidecars, with no filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Electrode coordinates are not available.
